formattedAddress: 100, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Longfu Village, Section 2, Chongqing S Rd, 51號B1永豐餘大樓內

text.text:
We were looking for a nice brunch spot to celebrate our daughter's birthday and found this place on Google Maps. This is located in the basement and is attached to a natural produce market.

The restaurant is really spacious and there were a lot of groups and families on a Sunday afternoon. The place was really buzzing.

The service was friendly, attentive and quick unlike some of the previous reviews that said that service was slow.

We ordered the following :

1) Latte - a nice latte, but not the strongest of coffees.
2) Porridge for our baby
3) Seafood bolognese pasta - large crunchy prawns, lots of cauliflower and mushrooms in this tasty pasta.
4) Fried chicken thigh - this was just ok in my opinion. It comes with a dollop of mashed pumpkin.
